page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_8_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture providing 416 dedicated virtual CPUs. Designed to support massive memory footprints, the platform provides 7600.0 GB of RAM, resulting in approximately 18.27 GB of memory per core. Dedicated CPU allocation provides uniform compute capacity free from multi-tenant processor contention.

Storage and acceleration configurations include a 429 GB local solid-state drive with Premium Storage support, which serves high-speed scratch space, paging files, or temporary application runtime directories. The instance features no discrete GPUs, orienting all hardware resources strictly toward host CPU execution. Networking defaults provide zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard external network allocation if outside connectivity is necessary.

From an infrastructure profile perspective, the M416ds_8_v3 is engineered for extreme resource density rather than general computing. The trade-off between immense core density and high memory-per-core volume makes it specific to monolithic, highly demanding architectures. Target workloads include massive in-memory databases like SAP HANA, extensive enterprise resource planning systems, high-capacity data warehousing, and intensive transactional analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure M416ds_8_v3 is an enterprise memory-optimized virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features an x86_64 Intel processor deploying 416 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 7600.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high memory-to-core ratio of 18.27 GB per vCPU. Local storage is supplied via an integrated 429 GB solid-state drive with Premium Storage capabilities, suited for high-speed scratch space, temporary storage, or operational swap files. The configuration contains no discrete GPUs and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Engineered for scenarios demanding unprecedented memory density and substantial parallel compute threads, the M416ds_8_v3 is intended for massive in-memory enterprise databases such as SAP HANA, large-scale transactional processing systems, memory-heavy data warehousing, and intensive business intelligence analytics that require continuous retention of vast datasets directly within volatile memory.
